The lower level is set up for in-law or extended-family living, with its own living/dining area, a fourth bedroom, and a full bathroom with shower, along with a utility room and extra storage.Outside, the fully fenced backyard offers a patio for entertaining and a garden area. Enjoy a great commuter location close to Legacy Place, with easy access to Washington Street and bus service to Forest Hills Station, and just minutes to Millennium Park, the Arnold Arboretum, and the Blue Hills Reservation. A must-see!

Discover exceptional space and versatility in this beautifully updated Colonial, offering four finished levels designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. The main level features a warm cherry kitchen that opens to a formal dining area with elegant built-ins, while sliding glass doors lead to a sun-filled three-season porch overlooking the expansive, fenced backyard. Newly refinished hardwood floors enhance the inviting living room, and an additional room provides the perfect setting for a home office. The finished lower level offers an impressive family room with bar seating, shelving, a sink, a second fireplace, a full bath, and a separate laundry room. Upstairs, the third level includes the primary suite and three additional bedrooms with generous closet space. The fourth level adds a carpeted landing and bonus room for even greater flexibility. Complete with solar panels, underground irrigation, an attached garage, and ample driveway parking, this spacious home is ready to impress! Conveniently located near Trader Joe's and Commuter Rail.

OPEN HOUSE SUN 11/8. Rare opportunity in one of West Roxbury's most sought-after neighborhoods, where homes on this desirable cul-de-sac seldom come to market! This charming 3-4 bedroom Cape blends classic character with exceptional versatility. Gleaming hardwood floors flow throughout, while a cozy gas fireplace creates the perfect gathering spot in the living room. A first-floor bedroom offers flexibility for guests, a home office, or one-level living. The full finished basement is a standout feature, offering incredible potential for an ADU, complete with an existing full bathroom and kitchenette. Step outside to a spacious deck overlooking a private backyard-ideal for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying warm summer evenings. A rare combination of location, charm, space, and future potential, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss!

Welcome to this charming 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Colonial, ideally located in a desirable neighborhood close to shops, schools, parks, and transportation. The spacious eat-in kitchen features a center island and offers plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining. The home also includes a formal living room, dining room with wainscoting and a lovely bow window, fireplaced family room, and dedicated home office. The finished lower level provides additional flexible living space. A deck offers a pleasant spot for outdoor dining and relaxing, while the 2-car garage provides added convenience.

Welcome to this charming Cape, nestled on one of the cutest streets in town! Step inside this bright and airy home, where a comfortable and flowing floor plan welcomes you.The spacious living room features a large picture window that fills the space with natural light, a beautiful wood-burning fireplace with dentil moulding, and hardwood floors that continue throughout the home. The living room opens to a versatile adjoining space that can be used as a cozy sitting area, home office, playroom, or whatever best suits your needs.The beautifully updated kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a large breakfast bar with plenty of seating. A dedicated dining area provides the perfect setting for everyday meals or entertaining guests.There is also plenty of potential for future expansion! The lower level features a large, open basement with direct walkout access to the patio and backyard. Some updates include roof and gutters 2018 and boiler 2023. Outside, enjoy a lovely fenced-in yard with mature plantings and a convenient storage shed.Ideally located near major highways, restaurants, shops, public transportation, the VA Hospital, and more, this home offers both charm and convenience. Come see all that this wonderful property has to offer-you won't want to miss it!

Beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home. Full gut renovation w/ everything new throughout. The first floor features an open-concept layout w/ a custom kitchen, two-tone cabinetry, stone countertops and backsplash, stainless steel appliances, large dining area, and spacious living room with direct access to an expansive 180-degree rear deck. The second floor offers four generously sized bedrooms, including a large primary suite w/ tall ceilings, walk-in closet, and private spa-like bath w/ double vanity, oversized tiled shower, and freestanding soaking tub. Second-floor laundry for added convenience. The fully finished basement includes a full bathroom, theater/media room, and additional flexible space for a gym, office, playroom, or guest area. Everything has been updated from top to bottom, including a new roof, siding, windows, electrical, plumbing, mechanicals, central heat and AC, and spray-foam insulation. Hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, attached garage, driveway parking, and a fenced corner lot complete the property. This home offers the space and finishes of a new home without giving up the character and convenience of an established West Roxbury neighborhood. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, public transportation, commuter rail, and major routes. Completely finished, move-in ready, and designed for both everyday living and entertaining.

Premium Transformation on Woodley Ave, Nothing To Do but Move In! Fully renovated 3BR/2BA on a quiet West Roxbury private way. All-new systems, windows, floors, finishes and a beautifully transformed backyard. Brand-new kitchen with quartz counters, full-height quartz backsplash, maple cabinets, under-cabinet lighting, stainless steel appliances, outdoor-venting hybrid microwave/convection oven. Off the kitchen, a sunlit room that opens to the backyard - ideal as lounge, home office or guest entertaining area. Two floor-to-ceiling tiled full baths with built-in storage closets: one with a deep steel soaking tub, one with a wall-to-wall walk-in shower and glass door. New 4" white oak hardwood throughout with premium protective finish. Brand-new windows, mostly triple-pane for energy efficiency, incl. a large bay and 2 architectural windows that flood the home with natural light. Mineral wool soundproofing in all bath walls and the ceiling between basement and 1st floor, acoustic rubber underlayment between 1st and 2nd floors, 1.75" solid-core interior doors throughout. All-new major systems: Bosch 2-zone heat pump (central A/C and heating) with gas furnace backup, 80-gal Wi-Fi heat pump water heater w/ leak detection, Wi-Fi Bosch HVAC controls. A 200amp Leviton smart-ready electrical panel with whole-home surge protection, pre-wired with two dedicated electrical circuits for additional appliances, AFCI/GFCI on most circuits and EV-charger pre-wire. Newly finished basement: 2 versatile rooms you can use as additional bedrooms, office, gym, media, playroom or recreation spaces, mechanical room with a stainless steel sink and storage area, additional closet and a dedicated laundry room with gas and electric laundry hookups. Freshly reimagined backyard built for summer nights and slow gardening mornings. CertainTeed roof (2022) with transferable warranty. Granite front and rear stairs, Techo-Bloc patio and walkways, custom landscape lighting, updated and powered shed, refreshed landscaping, newly paved driveway and parking for 3+ cars. Ring doorbell and cameras. On the bus line, close to commuter rail, major highways, Centre Street shops and restaurants, Dedham Mall, Legacy Place & Longwood Medical Area. Boston residential exemption reduces property taxes by $4,354 for qualified owner occupants.

***PRICE IMPROVEMENT***Welcome to 116 Running Brook Road, a well-maintained brick-front raised ranch on a corner lot in one of West Roxbury's most established neighborhoods. The open-concept main level features a living room and dining room with lovely hard wood floors, and a kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite counters, and tile flooring. Sliders off the dining room lead to a sun-room/porch, perfect for morning coffee or easy access to the yard. Three bedrooms (all w/ hardwood floors) and a full bath complete the main level, which also enjoys central air. The lower level adds remarkable flexibility, with a large family room anchored by a fireplace with a pellet stove insert (ideal as a den, rec room, or both), a fourth bedroom, a second full bath, a laundry area / bonus room perfect for a home office. Exterior vinyl siding and vinyl windows make for low-maintenance living. Outside, the 5,441 sq ft corner lot offers a fenced-in yard and a lovely patio with a fire pit, plus a one-car garage for parking and extra storage. Commuting is easy, with the bus line about a five-minute walk away and the commuter rail to downtown Boston a short drive. Enjoy everything the city has to offer, or head the other way to the shopping, dining, and entertainment at Legacy Place in Dedham.

Charming & Classic 1930's cape style home on tree lined street. Enter the home through the cozy foyer leading to the sunny living room with brick fireplace surrounded by original built-in bookcases. A French door leads to 3 season porch overlooking the side yard. Formal dining room and updated kitchen. Convenient first floor bedroom and renovated full bath with walk-in shower. Additionally, there is another bedroom/den on the first floor. Upstairs are 2 additional bedrooms plus bonus room that could be used as nursery or office. Original full bath. Direct access attic offers plenty of storage or for future expansion. The large landing could easily hold a desk or makes for a cozy reading nook. Cedar closet just waiting for your summer wardrobe. Great opportunity for future owners looking to make this house your own. Easy access to Centre St, shops and restaurants. Minutes to Chestnut Hill Shopping and Medical area. Three commuter rail stops and bus on LaGrange Street to Forest Hills.

Thoughtfully updated classic West Roxbury home with four bedrooms, great outdoor space, a two-car garage, and an impressive list of recent improvements. With more than 1,600 sq. ft. of living space, this home has the character you want in an older Boston home along with many of the big updates already taken care of. Step inside to beautiful hardwood floors and a warm, comfortable layout with plenty of room to spread out. The first floor offers a spacious living room with a fireplace, a dining room, a kitchen, and a bright sunroom that gives you flexible bonus space for an office, playroom, or a cozy place to relax. Upstairs are four bedrooms, giving you options for family, guests, or working from home. A walk-up attic provides additional storage and future possibilities.Extensive updated including electrical rewiring, refinished floors, new interior doors, repairs to walls and ceilings, fresh paint throughout, added insulation and weather sealing, a newer heat pump and water heater, and a new basement bathroom. The home has also been deleaded according to Massachusetts guidelines. A newer roof, updated dormer siding, gutters and downspouts, and newer kitchen appliances add even more peace of mind.Outside, enjoy a yard with plenty of space to garden, play, entertain, or simply relax. The detached two-car garage is a rare find in the city and provides plenty of room for parking and storage. All of this in a great location with easy access to neighborhood shops, restaurants, parks, schools, public transportation, and everything the area has to offer.

Welcome to a truly special home where classic character meets modern comfort. Tucked away on a private road, this beautifully maintained single-family residence offers a warm and inviting atmosphere from the moment you arrive. Step inside to bright, sun-filled rooms filled with charm and thoughtful details, including graceful bay windows, beautiful stained-glass accents, new light fixtures, and recessed LED lighting throughout. The open-concept living and dining spaces flow effortlessly together, creating the perfect setting for cozy evenings at home or entertaining family and friends. The heart of the home is the gorgeous gourmet kitchen, featuring elegant stone countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and a spacious peninsula that naturally invites conversation, casual meals, and memorable gatherings. Outside, enjoy your morning coffee or unwind at the end of the day on the welcoming front porch, complete with durable Trex decking. The rear deck and patio overlooks a versatile backyard, offering plenty of room to relax, garden, entertain, or simply enjoy your own private outdoor retreat.Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms, a beautifully updated full bathroom, and a charming home office-perfect for remote work, reading, or a quiet creative space. The updated bathrooms feature imported tile, contemporary vanities, and a stylish walk-in shower.Modern conveniences include central A/C, a modern heat pump, in-unit washer and dryer, off-street parking, and a full walkout basement offering abundant storage and exciting potential for future use.Ideally situated near major highways, shopping, restaurants, and everyday amenities, this home offers a peaceful private setting without giving up convenience. With its inviting spaces, timeless details, modern updates, and wonderful outdoor areas, this is more than a house-it's a place to feel at home.

This home is a total vibe! From the moment you walk through the door, you'll find a perfect mix of classic West Roxbury charm, thoughtful updates, and seriously stylish spaces. Warm hardwood floors, beautiful architectural details, and an inviting layout create a home that feels comfortable, collected, and completely your own. Enter through a small vestibule and hang your coat in the spacious front closet. The living and dining spaces flow effortlessly, making everyday life easy and entertaining even better. The kitchen is beautiful and functional, with unique custom cabinetry, a coordinated backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and generous prep space. A full bathroom with tub and two bedrooms complete this floor, with one opening directly to a brand-new, gorgeous back deck, perfect for morning coffee or dining al fresco. Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom feels like a true retreat, complete with vaulted ceilings, excellent closet space (walk-in + more!) and a stunning custom bathroom that feels more like a boutique hotel than your everyday bath. Gorgeous finishes, a double vanity, skylight, and a luxurious shower make this a space you'll definitely look forward to using. Need more room? The finished basement gives you valuable bonus living space. There's also a convenient half bath and plenty of storage in the utility room, where you'll also find the washer and dryer. And don't miss the secret nook, a fun little space ready to become a favorite hideaway! And then there's the backyard. With a private, freshly sodded yard, gardening spaces, and the incredible new deck, your outdoor space is made for lingering and enjoying. The under the home "garage" is perfect for storing yard tools or utilizing as a home gym space. All of this in an incredible location, just moments from the shops, restaurants, coffee, parks, and neighborhood favorites of Centre Street, with easy access to the commuter rail and everything Boston has to offer. Full of perks and personality, this is one you'll want to experience for yourself.

This lovely single family home is located on a quiet stretch of the parkway, high up and set back, among tall and lush trees for complete privacy. A quality renovation of the kitchen and baths was done in 2008 and well cared for since, making this a turn-key home.The main floor boasts an expansive and flowing floor plan, with lots of large windows. A charming kitchen opens to a large dining area and living area. Additional space in the kitchen allows for a second eat-in area and access to a deck out back and stairs that lead to a wooded and flat outdoor retreat. The hallway off the living room leads to three generous bedrooms and a full bath. The lower level is huge, with endless possibilities for a second living room, a playroom, a home office, an exercise room,, whatever the new owner wishes. A second full bath, large laundry room, big stoarge closet and an additional 350sf of unfinished space complete the lower level. Attached garage. Easy access to all the amenities in West Roxbury Center, Roslindale Village, downtown Boston and the beautiful Arboretum.Walk to T and playground. Easy access to bike path to Boylston St., Faulkner Hospital

Welcome home to 184 Perham Street, a captivating single-family residence that effortlessly marries classic architectural charm with the luxury of modern, top-to-bottom renovations. Location is everything! West Roxbury is one of Boston's most sought-after neighborhoods - enjoy a quiet suburban feel while still being incredibly close to Longwood medical area, vibrant shops and dining options along Centre Street, YMCA, local parks, and schools: Boston College, Roxbury Latin, Catholic Memorial, Brimmer & May, Beaver, St Sebs, and Nobles. Nestled on a picturesque, tree-lined street, this turn-key 4 well-appointed bedroom, 3 1/2 bathroom colonial home offers sun-drenched, open floor plan living/dining, beautifully designed kitchen with white shaker inset cabinets with quartz counters, large private family room opens into the private backyard perfect for entertaining guests. Wide staircase opens smartly to a second floor, a primary bedroom with stunning vaulted ceilings, en-suite bath and large walk-in shower. Only steps from the West Roxbury commuter rail for a seamless trip into Back Bay and downtown Boston! Commuting by car is also a breeze with quick access to the VFW Parkway, Route 1, and Route128 & Amtrak station.
